{{Top|leg}}
'''Star Tours Flight 922''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was stationed at the spaceport's Gate 2D, and its status was on time with an estimated time of arrival at 1350 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1445.
